text: {"1118":{"about":["rustc_ast"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_ast is designed as the syntax-layer parser crate and is kept independent of other rustc crates."},"1119":{"about":["rustc_ast","rustc_middle","rustc_lint"],"refers":[],"why":"This describes rustc_ast's dependency boundary and locates the normal lint infrastructure in rustc_middle and rustc_lint."},"1120":{"about":["rustc_ast","rustc_session"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_ast defines the parser-safe buffered-lint representation, while rustc_session's ParseSess buffers it."},"1121":{"about":["rustc_interface","rustc_session"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"The compilation pipeline transfers parser buffered lints into rustc_session's Session storage after expansion."},"1122":{"about":["rustc_session","rustc_errors"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_session handles the diagnostic-format option and rustc_errors emits diagnostics using its JSON emitter."}}
